text:
marta: Kestrel dedicated bring-up: customer requested regional split (us-west1 + eu-west1) for compliance. Need quota reservations per region, autoscale policies aligned, and a synced load test plan. Renewal risk flagged if SLA breaches during onboarding. Can CS/SRE coordinate?

ev an: typo -> evan: We can do regional reservations. Suggest reserve 4 GPUs in us-west1 and 3 in eu-west1 for the 48h prime, with 1 standby node per region for burst. Need the exact target RPS per region and working hours.

drew: Runtime note: set per-region batching to keep p95 < 300ms. For eu-west1, consider slightly smaller batch_size=3 due to avg token length. Also recommend KV cache prefill per-region.

sophia: Customer confirms window Thu 2026-04-07 18:00 UTC, 48h. Regional split approx 65% west / 35% eu. We'll run smoke & correctness checks first and then ramp. Also capturing enablement: we'll host a 30-min handoff with their infra team 24h before.

ev an: For load plan, propose phased ramp: 30m smoke @50rps, 2h ramp to steady (us-west1 975 rps, eu-west1 525 rps), 6h steady, then 18h soak. Include short spike probes: 5m @200% every 6h.

drew: Autoscale rules (region-local):
- scale_up when pending_requests > 40 OR avg_gpu_util > 70% for 45s
- scale_down when pending_requests < 8 for 4m AND avg_gpu_util < 45%
- max_nodes_per_region = reserved_nodes + 1 standby
Fallback policy: Gracefully degrade to quantized model and disable long-context paths if mem pressure.

sophia: Re: renewal risk: finance needs to approve transient quota spend over committed baseline. @marta can you confirm SLA acceptance criteria and if the customer has a credit hold?

marta: Finance: tentative yes for this onboarding spend; I'll get final sign-off today. SLA acceptance: p95 < 350ms, error_rate < 0.5% over the steady period, and no sustained throttling. If we fail, we offer a 30-day credit and a remediation plan.

ops-bot: Created job 'kestrel-regional-warmup' scheduled 2026-04-07T18:00Z by marta. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kestrel-warmup. Pager escalation: eng-oncall -> infra-sre.

ev an: Test commands (example vegeta targets use region-specific hostnames):

```bash
# smoke
vegeta attack -targets=us_targets.txt -rate=50 -duration=30m | vegeta report -type=json > smoke_us.json
# ramp to steady
vegeta attack -targets=us_targets.txt -rate=975 -duration=6h | vegeta report -type=json > steady_us.json
# spike probe
vegeta attack -targets=eu_targets.txt -rate=1050 -duration=5m | vegeta report -type=json > spike_eu.json
```

drew: Also add a small synthetics run to validate golden prompts and output schema before canary completion. We'll fail the run if any schema mismatch.

sophia: I'll upload the golden prompt set and expected schema to the ticket. Customer will provide IAM service account and KMS key alias: projects/kestrel/keys/bringup-key.

marta: Action items: 1) SRE reserve regional nodes + confirm autoscale knobs (evan/drew) 2) Finance finalize transient quota spend (marta) 3) CS share traffic files, IAM and golden prompts (sophia) 4) Run canary 12h before main window and post results here.

evan: ETA for reservations: 24h. I'll post node ids once reserved.

drew: I'll prepare the autoscale policy and a short rollback play (route traffic to hosted-fallback and scale to zero in region) and paste commands here.

ops-bot: Reminder: if p95 > 600ms during steady for >10min, automated mitigate will trigger and page eng-oncall.

sophia: Thanks team. We'll capture the enablement notes in the kickoff doc and include renewal owner in follow-up. :rocket:
